notes: Config keeps qk_rope_head_dim 64 while setting mla_use_nope; the report says K3 applies NoPE to all MLA layers.
kv_heads 96 is nominal for MLA, as for DeepSeek-V3.
Parent is Kimi Linear: the report says K3 follows its hybrid design; it compares scaling efficiency against Kimi K2.
Kimi K3.1 Pro (seed) turns these 24 gated MLA layers into gated DSA; the rest of the config matches.
